content: Ubbaafe Aadhey Oonee?
He wode Yesuusa tamaareti yidi, “Salo kawotethan ubbaafe aadhey oonee?” yaagidi oychidosona.
Yesuusi issi guutha na7a xeegidi enta giddon essidi haysada yaagis.
“Taani hintew tuma odayis; hinte laametonnanne guutha naytada hanonna ixiko salo kawotethaa ubbaraka gelanaw danda7eketa.
Hiza, ha guutha na7ada bana kawushiya oonika salo kawotethan ubbaafe aadheysa gidana.
Haysa mela na7a ta sunthan mokiya oonika tana mokees.
“Shin tanan ammaniya ha guuthatape issuwa nagara oothana mela dhube gidiya oonika gita gaacha woxa ba qoodhen qachidi ciimmo abban mitetiko iyaw lo77o.
Alamen asay nagara oothana mela oothiyabati de7iya gisho alamiya ayye! Hessa melabati yoonna attenna, shin dhubey iya gaason yaa uraa ayye!
“Ne kushey woyko ne tohoy nena balethiko neepe qanxa yegga. Neeni nam7u kushera woyko nam7u tohora merinaa taman yegetanaape kushe woyko toho duuxa gidada merinaa de7o demmeysi new lo77o.
Qassi ne ayfey nena balethiko iyo wooca kessada wora hola. Neeni nam7u ayfera gaanname taman yegeteysafe issi ayfera merinaa de7uwa geleysi new lo77o.
“Ta hintew odayis; salon de7iya enta naagiya kiitanchoti ubba wode salon de7iya ta Aawa sinthan de7iya gisho, hinte ha guuthatape issuwaka kadhonna mela naagetite.
Asa Na7ay dhaydaysata ashshanaw yis”
yaagis.
Dhayda Dorsa Leemiso
Qassi Yesuusi, “Hintew ay daanii? Issi uraas xeetu dorsati de7eysatape issoy dhayiko uddufun tammanne uddufunata deriya bolla yeggi aggidi he dhayidaysa koyanaw beennee?
Ta tuma odayis; I demmida wode uddufun tammanne uddufunatape aathidi dhayidi bentida issi dorsa gisho ufaytees.
Hessadaka, salon de7iya hinte aaway ha guuthatape issoy dhayana mela koyenna.
Qohida Asi Waatanee?
“Ne ishay nena qohiko nerka iyako bada iya qohuwa iyaw oda. I nena si7iko iya new isha ootha.
Shin I nena si7onna ixiko, nam7u woyko heedzu asa markan mootoy lasetiya gisho, issi woyko nam7u asi ekada iyako ba.
I entana si7onna ixiko, woosa keethas oda. Woosa keethi giyaba si7onna ixiko ammanonna asada woyko qaraxa qanxisiya asada iya payda.
“Ta hintew tuma odayis; sa7an hinte diggiyabati ubbay salon Xoossaa matan digetidaba gidana. Sa7an hinte hano giyabati ubbay salon Xoossa matan hanidaba gidana.
“Qassika ta hintew odayis; sa7an hintefe nam7ay banta woossiyabas issi wozanan gididi Xoossaa woossiyaba gidiko salon de7iya ta Aaway hintew oothana.
Tana kaalleysatape nam7a woyko heedza gididi shiiqiya bessan taani enta giddon bentana” yaagis.
Atto Guussaba
He wode Phexroosi Yesuusako yidi, “Godaw, ta ishay tana qohiko aapun toho taani atto gaanaw bessii? Laapun toho gakanaaseyee?” gidi oychis.
Yesuusi zaaridi, “Gidenna, laapun tammu toho laapunape attishin, laapun toho gidenna.
“Hessa gisho, Xoossaa kawotethay ba oosanchotara ba miishey pacidaakonne palahidaako be7anaw qopida kawa daanees.
He kawoy miishey pacidaakonne palahidaako be7iya wode daro gindiginda acoy de7iya issi uraa iyako ehidosona.
Shin he aylley acuwa qanxanaw xoonetin iyara, iya machera, iya naytinne iyaw de7iyabay ubbay bayzetidi acoy cigetana mela iya goday kiittis.
Yaatin aylley ba godaa tohuwa bolla gulbatidi, ‘Ta godaw, hayyana guutha wode takarki, ta acuwa ubbaa ta ciggana’ yaagidi woossis.
Kawoy iyaw qadhetidi, yeddi aggis; iya acuwa maaris.
“Shin he aylley keyi bidi ba lagge oosanchotape issoy baape daro guutha miishe tal7idaysa, ‘Ne bolla de7iya ta miishiya taw cigga’ gidi qoodhe oykis.
“He iya lagee aylley iya sinthan gulbatidi, ‘Hayyana guutha wode takarki taani ta acuwa ubbaa ciggana’ yaagidi woossis.
“Shin ixidi eki efidi ba laggey acuwa qanxana gakanaw qasho keethi gelsis.
Hessa gisho, hara lagge oosanchoti hessa be7ida wode daro yilotidi, bidi banta godaas I oothidaba ubbaa odidosona.
“Yaatin kawoy he aylliya xeegisidi, ‘Ha iita aylliyaw, neeni tana woossida gisho, ta ne acuwa ubbaa new maaras.
Yaatin, taani ne acuwa maaridaysada neeni ne lagge aylliya acuwa maaranaw new bessennee?’ yaagis.
Hessa gisho, kawoy daro yilotidi, I ba acuwa ubbaa ciggana gakanaw paxa kaa7etana mela qasho keethan yeggis.
“Hessadaka, hinte issoy issoy hinte ishaa wozanape maaronna ixiko salon de7iya ta Aaway hintena hessada oothana” yaagis.
